page.overview:
What is Chorus Fruit?

Chorus fruit is a food item native to the End that can be eaten, or smelted into popped chorus fruit. It can be eaten even when the hunger bar is full, and eating it may teleport the player up to 8 blocks in any direction.

Chorus fruit can be obtained by breaking chorus plant blocks. Each block of chorus plant has a 50% chance to drop a chorus fruit. This is not affected by Fortune.

To eat chorus fruit, press and hold while it is selected in the hotbar. Eating one restores hunger and 2.4 hunger saturation.

Unlike most foods, chorus fruits can be eaten even when the player has a full hunger bar.
